scope: native tests in the focused HTTP headers harness; these are runtime parity checks, not Creusot proofs

tests.command: source /workspace/proof-tools/activate.sh && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/http-headers-native-luna-name RUSTFLAGS='--cfg http_header_name_leaf -Zcrate-attr=feature(stmt_expr_attributes,proc_macro_hygiene)' RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg http_header_name_leaf -Zcrate-attr=feature(stmt_expr_attributes,proc_macro_hygiene)' cargo test --manifest-path http/1.5.0/verification/headers/Cargo.toml --lib --locked --offline
tests.coverage_note: The focused name leaf includes standard token parsing, bounds, equality/hash, bytes conversion, and manual Debug parity tests.

tests.command: source /workspace/proof-tools/activate.sh && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/http-headers-native-luna-value-profile RUSTFLAGS='--cfg http_header_value_complete -Zcrate-attr=feature(stmt_expr_attributes,proc_macro_hygiene)' RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg http_header_value_complete -Zcrate-attr=feature(stmt_expr_attributes,proc_macro_hygiene)' cargo test --manifest-path http/1.5.0/verification/headers/Cargo.toml --lib --locked --offline
tests.coverage_note: Includes HeaderValue::test_debug and conversion tests against the current formatter source. This focused profile disables the map integration test because the harness omits HeaderMap.

diagnostics.reason: The harness omits HeaderMap, while a production integration test in value.rs refers to it unless http_header_value_complete is set. The corrected profile above passes.
